motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Honestly, there's no way around it, protecting my friends is important!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: No, Sterling can't retreat yet! Lady Matilda, help me cover everyone's rear!

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Aw, these wounds are nothing! Just fix them up however you want! Sterling's teammates can't do without her!

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Hmph, so the power of Darkness is welling up now, is it?

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: So she was there too... In that case, I can't idle around! Give me a mission! Right! Now! Immediately! This is to settle matters between me and Sten...

motions.name: login
motions.line: Sshhh — the miracle-coveting Army of Darkness is waiting for us.

motions.name: login
motions.line: Lady Matilda, go see what the new girl is like.

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: You couldn't find me today? I was scouting out the lair of the Army of Darkness. You were worried I got captured? Hmph, if the enemy could actually do that, I'd be cheering them on.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Sshhh — the miracle-coveting Army of Darkness is waiting for us.

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: So I'm just taking care of documents today? When will I get to go on the frontlines... That would be a heavenly assignment for Strling!

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: You really are a patient one... Well, Sterling isn't going to wait around! Let me know when something good happens, I'm going to go take a walk!

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: The enemy must be very happy that Sterling is in your office. Otherwise, they'd all be dead by now!

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Lady Matilda, what's that you're holding in your beak... A gift from the Commander? <> So you actually wanted to go adventuring with me? And you were making such a big fuss about it at first... <> Well, at least you understand now! The future has limitless possibilities when you're with me!

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: So you've seen the true face of the Army of Darkness? You didn't fight them, did you? They're too dangerous for a human like you, Commander... You saw me and Lady Matilda fight a pack of stray cats? So you already knew...
